faqs.q: Why does the price to buy Telegram Accounts differ by country?
faqs.a: Telegram prices Accounts in local currency for each region, so the USD equivalent varies. We pass that regional pricing straight to you instead of charging one flat rate for everyone.

faqs.q: How fast will I receive my Telegram Accounts after I buy?
faqs.a: Orders are typically delivered to your Telegram account shortly after payment is confirmed.

faqs.q: Do I need to share my Telegram password to buy Accounts?
faqs.a: No. We only need your Telegram username to deliver Accounts — never your password or login code.
